subject: Review gate schedule & manager liaison coordination
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Review gate schedule & manager liaison coordination

Team —

I put together a concise gate-and-liaison plan for this year’s performance cycle. The goal is to limit exposure for sensitive roles, reduce synchronous calibration time, and ensure managers have one clear liaison for any confidentiality or legal escalation. Please review the checklist and the liaison list I attached and confirm two things by EOD Tuesday:

1) Whether your org needs a staggered review window (yes/no). If yes, suggest a 2–3 day window.
2) Confirm the manager liaison (name + email) who will own sensitive-role communications and escalation.

Key constraints:
- Privileged roles (Infra/Security/Legal-facing) must have HR + Legal sign-off before any score distribution.
- We will redact verbatim sensitive comments when sharing summaries with cross-functional partners.
- In regions where we have additional compliance (EU), the cadence will be shifted to accommodate DPO reviews — I’ll loop in global HR where relevant.

Attachments: review_gate_checklist.xlsx; manager_liaison_list.csv; comm_templates_v1.docx

High-level timeline:
- Nov 8 — manager calibration packets distributed
- Nov 15–22 — manager reviews (staggered by team where requested)
- Nov 23–Dec 1 — HR/Legal sign-offs for privileged roles
- Dec 4 — finalization and comms out to employees

If you have an org-specific constraint (hiring freezes, regional leave windows, grander restructures), flag it here and we’ll carve the plan accordingly.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov | VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference

On Sun, 1 Nov 2026 at 09:12 Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> I put together a concise gate-and-liaison plan for this year’s performance cycle...

Thanks, Olga — this is helpful. Two quick items from Eng:

- We should run an asynchronous calibration window (Slack + Miro) the week before Nov 15 for all managers who cannot attend live. That reduces late edits and accelerates sign-off.
- One of our senior infra leads will need Legal on the loop earlier than Nov 23; that person is on a cross-company risk review and Legal asked to see any calibration notes by Nov 18. Can we move that case up?

I’ll confirm the manager liaison by EOD Tuesday.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Director, Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:20:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Review gate schedule & manager liaison coordination

Agree with the plan. A couple of operational suggestions:

- Stagger reviews for Infra and Sec teams: suggested windows Nov 15–17 (Infra) and Nov 18–20 (Sec). That lets Legal focus on a single cohort each week.
- Add an audit column in the checklist for tokenized evidence (who saw what) — we had a requests gap last cycle.
- If we’re redacting verbatims, please include a short rationale field so managers can capture context (not the exact text).

I’ve marked two names on the liaison list (see attached CSV). I’ll follow up with a quick Zoom runbook for managers who have privileged reports.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform | Redwood Inference

From: Katie Barnes <katie@hrpartners.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:40:02 -0800
Subject: RE: Review gate schedule & manager liaison coordination

Hi all —

Thanks for looping me in. A few best-practice items from our end:

- Redaction protocol: keep verbatims in a secure folder (limited access) and publish only summary themes in the broader packet. Maintain an index (redaction-id) linked to the secure file for audit.
- Manager liaison training: 30-minute micro-session + checklist; we can run two live sessions (Nov 10, Nov 12) and record one.
- Documentation: use the Drive folder you linked (please ensure Drive permissions are limited to the liaison list + HR + Legal).

Link to suggested templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-review-cycle-templates

Happy to take the runbook and convert to a one-page quick reference for managers.

—Katie
Katie Barnes | Principal Consultant, HR Partners LLC

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Team —

Thanks for the quick turns. Final decisions and next actions below (please read and acknowledge):

Decisions:
- Stagger windows approved: Infra Nov 15–17; Sec Nov 18–20. All other teams Nov 15–22 as baseline.
- Legal sign-off for flagged individuals moved up to Nov 18 for cross-company risk reviews.
- We will implement the redaction-id index Katie recommended; secure folder access limited to liaison list + HR + Legal.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marcus: add audit evidence column to review_gate_checklist.xlsx and resend by Wed 11/4.
- Laura: confirm liaison name for Eng by EOD Tue 11/3.
- Neha: lock Drive permissions and create the secure folder; provide access log sample by Thu 11/5.
- Katie: produce manager micro-session slide deck + one-page runbook by Fri 11/6.
